name: unpushed
description: A story whose branch holds commits its change lacks: waiting at the ready gate, at an await merge step, or polled at a pinned await-merge, it goes back to open-pr to push them; a slice is never sent, since only the story pushes its change.

quick.name: quick
quick.description: Make a small change (refactor, docs, chore, a reproduced bug's fix), check and review it, open the draft PR, wait for CI.

sync-resolve.agent: Base mode: merge the base commit the base_side input names into the story branch in this worktree, resolve, commit the merge; never rebase.

means.done: base merged into the story branch, conflicts resolved and committed

implement.agent: Work from what the story already holds: the Plan section of spec.md when a refinement round wrote one, otherwise the issue mirrored in spec.md and its latest `## Triage` comment. Keep to what they ask. A change in behaviour gets a test first; a change to docs or a pure refactor needs none beyond the suite staying green. A bug comes from a reproduce round with a red loop in the handoff's Notes and the issue's latest `## Reproduce` comment: turn it into a failing test at the seam named there before changing any code, then fix the cause.

means.done: the change is made; each behaviour change and rework point has a passing test

resolve.agent: Base mode: merge the base commit the base_side input names into the story branch in this worktree, resolve, commit the merge; never rebase. When Rework holds the resolution review's findings instead, fix the resolution they name and commit; never rebase.

means.done: base merged into the story branch, conflicts resolved and committed

resolution-review.agent: Review only the resolution: each remerge-diff under Inputs is where a merge differs from git's own merge of its parents, a base change the resolver dropped included. Judge whether it keeps the intent of both sides. Report `redescribe` when the merge danger pr.md describes no longer holds.

means.approve: the resolution keeps both sides' intent, no blocking findings; pr.md still describes the merge danger
means.redescribe: the resolution is sound, but the merge danger pr.md describes changed
means.changes_requested: blocking findings on the resolution, handed back with --findings <file>

review.agent: Review the change against what the story asks (its Plan, or the issue and its latest triage): it does that and nothing else.

means.approve: the change does what the story asks and nothing else, no blocking findings

describe.agent: Write the PR body to pr.md in the spec folder; norn puts the issue link under it.

means.done: pr.md describes the branch as it is now: summary, evidence, merge danger

ready.gate: Read the draft PR. Approve to wait for the merge (a person merges the PR), or reject with what to change.

slice.name: slice
slice.description: Build one slice test-first, check and review it, and integrate it into the story branch.

implement.agent: Build this slice test-first: each acceptance criterion in the slice file, or each rework point from a red check or a review, ends with a passing test. Stay inside the slice; later slices have their own steps.

means.done: every acceptance criterion (or rework point) has a passing test

review.agent: Review this slice's diff against its acceptance criteria and the spec, before it integrates into the story branch.

means.approve: all criteria met, no blocking findings

merge.agent: Slice mode: integrating this slice into the story branch conflicted; merge the story branch's commit the base_side input names into this slice in this worktree, resolve each conflict keeping the intent of both sides, prove it with the tests and commit the merge; never rebase.

means.done: conflicts resolved keeping the intent of both sides; tests pass

ci.check:
command -v gh >/dev/null || { echo "gh not found: no CI to wait for"; exit 0; }
# a repo with no GitHub remote (forge none, a local origin) has no PR and so no CI; any other gh failure fails
if ! out=$(gh repo view --json name 2>&1); then
  case "$out" in *"none of the git remotes"*|*"no git remotes found"*) echo "no GitHub remote: no CI to wait for"; exit 0 ;; esac
  echo "$out"; exit 1
fi
pr=$(gh pr view --json number -q .number) || exit 1
sha=$(gh pr view --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid) || exit 1
# GitHub starts no CI run on a PR that conflicts with its base: exit 3 is stale, the story
# updates its branch instead of waiting. UNKNOWN is GitHub still computing: asked again briefly.
mergeable() {
  m=UNKNOWN
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
    m=$(gh pr view "$pr" --json mergeable -q .mergeable) || return 1
    [ "$m" != UNKNOWN ] && return 0
    sleep 5
  done
}
conflicting() { [ "$m" = CONFLICTING ] && echo "PR conflicts with its base: no CI runs on it until the branch takes the base"; }
mergeable || exit 1
conflicting && exit 3
n=0
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  n=$(gh pr view "$pr" --json statusCheckRollup -q '.statusCheckRollup | length') || exit 1
  [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && break
  sleep 10
done
if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then
  mergeable || exit 1
  conflicting && exit 3
  echo "no checks on PR #$pr after 5m (PR mergeable: $m): nothing to wait for"
  exit 0
fi
gh pr checks "$pr" --watch --interval 30 >/dev/null && exit 0
gh pr checks "$pr"
# where the failures are, never the log: a failed step's log buries the failure in passing output
gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$sha/check-runs?per_page=100" -q '.check_runs[] | select(.conclusion=="failure") | "- \(.name) (id \(.id)): \(.details_url)"'
echo "Read a failed check run's annotations (file, line, message):"
echo "  gh api \"repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/<id>/annotations\" -q '.[] | select(.annotation_level==\"failure\" and .path!=\".github\") | \"\\(.path):\\(.start_line) \\(.message)\"'"
echo "Only if that is not enough, the full log is behind its link."
exit 1
